item.text: {"question_id":"8B.10","answer":"By the end of 2023, Scholz’s government had converted a substantial but uneven portion of its stated and revealed program into law, institutions, and operating practice, but the supplied evidence does not establish durable achievement across more of the full portfolio than remained incomplete or fragile. Security and Ukraine policy moved from the 2022 Zeitenwende announcement toward formal architecture: the €100 billion Bundeswehr fund and 2% commitment were enacted or reaffirmed, Germany adopted its first National Security Strategy, expanded deployments and aid, and reported €24 billion in civilian and military support. These show attributable mobilization and implementation, but not durable capability realization: inherited readiness was poor, spending was initially slow, the fund was judged inadequate against existing deficiencies, and the 2023 strategy softened the 2% commitment to a multi-year average (BATCH-0015-E001; BATCH-0015-E003; BATCH-0015-E005; BATCH-0016-E006; BATCH-0014-E007; BATCH-0014-E008). Energy resilience was more visibly operationalized: LNG terminals, storage, emergency relief, and diversification were reported as implemented, although the account is official and does not independently verify all amounts or distributional effects; the court ruling then removed €60 billion from the climate-and-transformation fund and put planned industrial and climate investments at risk (BATCH-0016-E018; BATCH-0024-E013). Modernization and institutional reform produced several enacted measures, including smart-meter rules, municipal heat planning, supply-chain regulation, competition-law changes, whistleblower protection, police-check records, and electoral reform. However, the smart-meter and heat-planning measures had future deadlines and contested capacity requirements; the supply-chain law had limited reach and no reported enforcement results; the competition evidence shows enacted powers and existing agency activity rather than completed market outcomes; the electoral reform’s durability was not established; and independent experts found administrative digitalization far behind its target, with the OZG’s original goal missed and the amendment still lacking clear standards, timelines, costs, monitoring, and security rules (BATCH-0009-E003; BATCH-0009-E010; BATCH-0008-E009; BATCH-0007-E007; BATCH-0001-E022; BATCH-0008-E003; BATCH-0026-E006; BATCH-0034-R05-E001; BATCH-0009-E012). Social and migration programs similarly show partial conversion rather than durable realization: Bürgergeld, Wohngeld-Plus, care reform, BAföG support, temporary protection for Ukrainians, asylum counselling, and family reunification operated or were legally established, but take-up and service outcomes were incompletely measured; social-assistance and care pressures remained high, child poverty remained material despite a modest decline, reception capacity was severely strained, Afghan admissions were far below the announced pace, and removals had more failed than effective attempts, largely involving local-authority failures (BATCH-0026-E007; BATCH-0024-E008; BATCH-0027-E014; BATCH-0020-E007; BATCH-0020-E006; BATCH-0022-E009; BATCH-0024-E001; BATCH-0008-E004; BATCH-0011-R03-E011; BATCH-0011-R03-E013; BATCH-0011-R04-E014; BATCH-0011-R05-E005; BATCH-0011-R06-E006; BATCH-0022-E008). Economic and distributional outcomes were mixed: employment and lower-quintile wages improved, but GDP, private consumption, construction investment, and housing approvals fell, with substantial external, inherited, inflationary, interest-rate, and demand-related explanations (BATCH-0028-E001; BATCH-0028-E002; BATCH-0023-E001; BATCH-0009-E021; BATCH-0035-E007). The best-supported end-period judgment is therefore increased formal and operational conversion with some concrete short-term delivery, but mixed goal progress and fragile or untested durability—not demonstrated durable realization of a greater share of the whole program. Attribution is to Scholz’s coalition government and federal institutions rather than Scholz alone, and is further limited by Parliament, Länder, municipalities, agencies, allies, inherited deficiencies, external shocks, and judicial constraints. The moral worth of the programs did not affect this execution
